name: Eterna
source: Eterna Plc audited consolidated financial statements for the year ended 31 December 2025 (PricewaterhouseCoopers report dated 3 April 2026): consolidated statement of profit or loss, group column. Revenue 302,369,941 and cost of sales 286,885,505 in N thousands, stored in absolute naira; FY2024 comparative from the same statement. Operating expenses are selling and distribution 156,851 plus general and administrative 12,766,498. Operating profit 12,575,724 is the printed line and reconciles from gross profit less operating expenses plus other income 9,434,197 less impairment 18,695 plus net foreign exchange gain 599,135. Net finance costs are finance cost 5,319,965 less finance income 17,792. EPS is the printed basic figure in naira (2.24; 1.03) on 1,302,073,000 shares. Profit before tax less income tax ties to profit after tax in both years. Read 25 October 2026.
